Giant_Stump_Home.png.note: v6.9.4 the real Giant Stump raccoon home with its baked-in raccoons REMOVED (no other pixel changed). Sampled from the wiki image, a 1.6 in-game screenshot at exactly 3x, to 1 game px (x=3+3k, y=1+3k), crop 100,15..250,150, trimmed to 100x110. app/scripts/raccoon_clean.py then cuts out the 8 kit heads and the 2 door raccoons (their raccoon-grey pixels and the dark outline touching them); the 3 kits that sat in the trunk/roots leave oval dark hollows (ring 3e2724 = the stump's own outline brown, inside 2a1a19), edge notches are closed with the stump's outline colour and bark copied from the same row. Animated kits (Raccoon_Kit_Head.png, from the same screenshot) peek from the window, the hollows, the door and over the rim. Before v6.9.4: v6.9.1 the real Giant Stump raccoon home, UNMODIFIED. The wiki image is a 1.6 in-game screenshot at exactly 3x; nearest-centre sampled to 1 game px (x=3+3k, y=1+3k), crop 100,15..250,150 then trimmed to 100x110. Every kept pixel is copied as-is (stump, chimney, steps, door, lit window, the kits sitting on it, the two raccoons at the door); only the background is cut to transparency: grass/leaf greens, the tree trunk behind it, flowers, chimney smoke and the fence. Built by app/scripts/make-raccoon-home.py. The wiki has only this one (spring/summer) image of the stump and no seasonal variants, so every season uses it. The pre-storm tree ('Big_Tree.png' on the wiki) exists only as a screenshot with its crown cut off by the frame, in one season, so it could not be used.

Giant_Stump_Window_Bars.png.note: Same canvas as Giant_Stump_Home.png: only the stump's own window frame and mullion pixels inside the lit window's glass box (x26,y51,10x13), copied unchanged. Drawn over a peeking kit so the kit sits behind the glass bars.

Giant_Stump_Shadow.png.note: Not game art: a 108x14 stepped pixel ellipse in translucent dark green (three hard-edged rings, no blur) made by app/scripts/make-raccoon-home.py, to ground the stump on the meadow.
